description: This PHP class 'ConfigFileAPI' is part of the OrangeHRM system's installer API, extending the upgrader API. It handles POST requests related to configuration files during installation, including database info setup and encryption key file writing.

classes.name: ConfigFileAPI
classes.description: A PHP class extending the upgrader API to manage configuration file processing during the installation process, including database setup and encryption key handling.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to configure database info and encryption keys, returning error responses if key file writing fails.

methods.name: getRegistrationType
methods.description: Returns the registration type indicating installer start.
